articles.summary: TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) today reported results for the fiscal third quarter ended June 26, 2026. Third Quarter Highlights Net sales were a record $5.16 billion, an increase of 14% on a reported basis and 12% organically year over year, driven by growth in both the Industrial and Transportation segments.
